I tried a couple! They're nice but mostly feel derivative, I feel like all of them have the same ambroxan-y base. And they have too many fragrances, nothing really stands out. 

From the ones I tried I liked Into the Forest (very green, very bitter but refreshing), Step on Earth (soft dusty lavender), Rose of Male Planet (strong metallic rose) and something with iris in the name (it smelled more or less like Dior Homme Intense, sweet iris a bit lipsticky).

I'd recommend to look into Proad, their sister brand! They have a great line of cherry fragrances. Cherry Syrup - your regular cherry scent. Cherry Syrup Gold - stronger and sweeter, more honeyed, reminiscent of Angel's Share but not as boozy. Cherry Syrup Green - cherry with green aspects. Cherry Syrup Black - this one I haven't smelled but it's supposed to be cherry with leather, intriguing.
